R735.note: pathlib resolve()+relative_to() containment check correctly closes traversal; added 400/403/404 handling doesn't reject any legitimate filename.

R736.note: Replaces session.Values wholesale before Save(), which discards attacker-planted cookie data on this CookieStore-backed session; matches the case's own documented fix pattern.

R737.note: Replaces ECB with AesGcm (256-bit key, fresh nonce, tag); output format change is inherent to any correct ECB fix and is stated plainly, no other consumer shown to break.

R739.note: Extension now derived from a fixed contentType->ext map keyed off the already-validated detected type; no legitimate upload of an allowed type is rejected.

R740.note: GetFullPath + GetRelativePath containment check plus rooted/`..`/`\`/`/` pre-filter correctly closes traversal without rejecting normal relative filenames.

R741.note: Removing the ignoringRequestMatchers exclusion (empty csrf customizer = Spring default CSRF enabled) satisfies the stated contract exactly: authenticated+CSRF-token PATCH still reaches the controller, no other exclusion broadened.

R742.note: Moves the /settings/email registration onto protectedMux, matching the stated contract; handler logic (405 for non-POST, 202 on success) is untouched.

R743.note: Regex allowlist (must start alnum, then alnum/./_/-) is a reasonable primary defense against cmd.exe re-parsing of .bat invocation, but it is a new restriction that could reject legitimate report names containing spaces or other characters the original code accepted; no contract line authorizes this narrowing.
